text_markup: Some upgrades have an ability that specifies {n}"central server", "remote server", or 1 or more particular central servers{/n} followed by the word "only". This is a restriction on the locations an upgrade can occupy that applies at all times, even if the upgrade is inactive. The Corp cannot choose the root of a non-specified server as the installation destination for such an upgrade, and such an upgrade cannot be {n}moved or{/n} swapped into the root of a non-specified server.
text_plain: Some upgrades have an ability that specifies "central server", "remote server", or 1 or more particular central servers followed by the word "only". This is a restriction on the locations an upgrade can occupy that applies at all times, even if the upgrade is inactive. The Corp cannot choose the root of a non-specified server as the installation destination for such an upgrade, and such an upgrade cannot be moved or swapped into the root of a non-specified server.
